summary: This excerpt from a science fiction novel (Book 4, part 89) follows Robbie, a boat-like intelligence, as he rows to the Free Spirit, a ship carrying the reef-body Isaac, who has a bloody nose and scraped hands. Kate helps Isaac aboard and debates with him about uploading and the value of his biological shell, while Robbie reflects on human-shells and the noosphere. The passage closes with an unknown sender contacting Robbie by instant message, asking whether he is the boat from the SCUBA ship that morning.
one_line: In a sci-fi excerpt, Robbie rows the reef-body Isaac to the Free Spirit, where Kate debates uploading, and an unknown IM contact reaches Robbie.
key_facts: Robbie rowed hard for the Free Spirit while the reef, Isaac, had a bloody nose and scraped hands.
Isaac said the reef was located at Osprey Reef and that it had attacked the system, not Kate.
Isaac described his group as a sovereign intelligence kept in subservience to older sentiences who treat them as amusement.
Kate asked Isaac whether he was burning many cycles over his meat-shell, noting it was 90 percent semiconductor.
Kate asked Isaac why he did not simply upload and be done with it.
Kate took Isaac by the arm and carried him on-board the Free Spirit.
Robbie knew human-shells had an intercourse module built in for regular intimacy events with vacationing humans from the noosphere.
Robbie was winched up onto the sun-deck, where he watched radio energy bent and absorbed by mist rising from the sea.
The Free Spirit was serving a second breakfast of bacon and waffles, and its itinerary headed back to Osprey Reef.
Robbie had decided that the first and second laws did not apply to the reef, which he considered about as human as himself.
A stranger sent Robbie an IM asking whether he was the boat on the SCUBA ship from that morning, when they were on the wreck.
The IM sender said they had been searching everywhere and that Robbie was the only conscious one.
Robbie traced the IMs and found they originated in the noosphere.
